name: Will I have access to my kitchen during the renovation?

mainEntity.name: Will I have access to my kitchen during the renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a full kitchen renovation, access to your kitchen will be limited or unavailable during much of the construction phase, especially during demolition, plumbing, electrical, and flooring installation. We recommend setting up a temporary cooking station elsewhere in your home if possible. We will communicate clearly about access expectations and potential disruptions throughout the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Access to your kitchen will be limited or unavailable during a full renovation; a temporary cooking setup is recommended.
